facts.fact: The UNDP report says more than 4 million Malawi Social Registry (formerly UBR) household records, 75 percent, have been integrated with the National ID, with a module for real-time integration with NRB being built.
The report says Standard Bank, First Capital Bank, Mukuru and FINCA, on Reserve Bank directive, are developing or testing biometric interfaces to the NRB verification gateway for KYC in a pilot.
The report says Airtel and TNM have direct linkages with NRB and are running end-to-end tests of biometric validation for SIM registration ahead of a national-scale pilot, under a MACRA directive.
The report says a Karonga District pilot linking National ID and birth-certificate UINs to the Ministry of Health's electronic medical records was approved on 30 June 2025 for national scale-up.

facts.fact: The report says offline verification of Digital ID through digitally signed QR codes was successfully tested in 2024 in voter registration, 2 million people, and in agriculture programmes, 1.5 million farmers.
facts.system: Digitally signed QR code offline ID verification

facts.fact: The report says offline verification has authenticated 3.5 million citizens; it gives no date, so as_of is the published month.

facts.fact: The UNDP report says more than 4 million Malawi Social Registry (formerly UBR) household records, 75 percent, have been integrated with the National ID.

The report says the Social Registry is being upgraded with a new software platform and a dedicated module for real-time integration with NRB, for automated identity verification of all programme beneficiaries.

MWI.note: The report links the registry to the National ID only; no other sector is named, and it does not say how many programmes share the registry.
